scripts.dev: concurrently -n "TSC,ELECTRON" -c "blue,green" "tsc -w" "wait-on dist/main.js && nodemon --watch dist --ext js --exec 'npx electron .'"
scripts.package: cd ../rtc-frontend && npm run build && cd ../rtc-backend && npm run build && cd ../rtc-desktop && npm run build && npx electron-builder
scripts.package:win: cd ../rtc-frontend && npm run build && cd ../rtc-backend && npm run build && cd ../rtc-desktop && npm run build && npx electron-builder --win
scripts.package:mac: cd ../rtc-frontend && npm run build && cd ../rtc-backend && npm run build && cd ../rtc-desktop && npm run build && npx electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:linux: cd ../rtc-frontend && npm run build && cd ../rtc-backend && npm run build && cd ../rtc-desktop && npm run build && npx electron-builder --linux
